title: pleurospermum cruciatum
intro: Pleurospermum cruciatum, commonly known as Tree Parsley or Cross-berry, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family. The health benefits of Pleurospermum cruciatum include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a diuretic, analgesic, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating conditions such as urinary issues and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Pleurospermum cruciatum include flavonoids, terpenes, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
